boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colorado State University-Fort Collins
boards.description: Discover the essential late-night food destinations that fuel the Colorado State University community after hours, from iconic toasted subs to local calzone traditions.

cards.title: Cheba Hut "Toasted" Subs
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sandwiches on Laurel Street
cards.notes: Visit this campus staple for toasted subs and munchies; it stays open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays to serve the student crowd.
cards.short_summary: A counter-culture themed sandwich shop located directly across from campus on Laurel Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheba Hut at 104 E Laurel St is open until Midnight Sunday-Thursday and until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sandwiches & Sub Shop in Fort Collins 80524 | Cheba Hut
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on weekends; located on the northern edge of campus.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: The Official Late-Night Calzone of the Rams
cards.notes: Order a custom calzone at this student favorite that specializes in late-night delivery and walk-in service until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated calzone shop known for its extensive menu and very late operating hours near CSU.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough in Fort Collins is an official sponsor of the CSU Rams and offers late-night hours, typically until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.source_title: D.P. Dough | Downtown Fort Collins, CO
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Thursday through Saturday; located on College Avenue.

cards.title: Fat Shack
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fat Sandwiches and Deep-Fried Treats
cards.notes: Try a signature 'Fat Sandwich' at this College Avenue spot that keeps its kitchen running until 2:10 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant specializing in high-calorie sandwiches and fried desserts, popular for late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack at 706 S College Ave has online ordering hours until 2:10 AM.
cards.source_title: Fat Shack 706 South College Avenue - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Kitchen and ordering available until 2:10 AM daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookie Delivery Until 3:00 AM
cards.notes: Satisfy your sweet tooth with warm cookies delivered to your dorm or picked up in person until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery and walk-in service near the CSU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 646 S College Ave is open until 3:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Fort Collins, CO
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM on weekends and 1:00 AM on weeknights.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Chicken Finger Meals
cards.notes: Head south on College Avenue for chicken finger combos and signature sauce, with drive-thru service available until 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain known for its chicken fingers and late-night drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 2108 S College Ave is open until 2:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Fort Collins, CO, - 2108 S. College Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and dining available until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Almansita's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mexican Cuisine
cards.notes: Grab a California burrito or carne asada fries at this local Mexican spot that serves the community until 1:30 AM.
cards.short_summary: A local Mexican restaurant offering a variety of traditional dishes with late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Almansita's at 2567 S Shields St is open for online ordering and service until 1:25 AM.
cards.source_title: Almansita's 2567 South Shields Street - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:25 AM daily for late-night Mexican food.

cards.title: Silver Mine Subs
cards.subtitle: Mining-Themed Subs Open Until Midnight
cards.notes: Choose from over 20 sandwich options at this local sub shop that offers delivery and dine-in until Midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: A regional sandwich chain with a mining theme, known for late-night delivery and fresh ingredients.
cards.evidence_claim: The Silver Mine Subs location at 4619 S Mason St is open daily until Midnight.
cards.source_title: Order Online in Arizona, Colorado & Wyoming - Silver Mine Subs
cards.access_notes: Open daily until Midnight; delivery available to the CSU area.

cards.title: Ramskeller Pub & Grub
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late-Night Programs
cards.notes: Visit the Lory Student Center for pizza and pub food; check the schedule for late-night programs and live music throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus pub and gathering space located in the Lory Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramskeller in the Lory Student Center features late-night programs and live music throughout the academic year.
cards.source_title: Ramskeller - Lory Student Center - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 100 of the LSC; hours vary by event and academic calendar.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Diner Classics
cards.notes: Make the short trip to Mulberry Street for 24-hour breakfast classics like hashbrowns and waffles in a traditional diner setting.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner chain located near the I-25 and Mulberry intersection, serving breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House on Mulberry and I-25 is open 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: Late Night Munchies? Top 5 Fort Collins Restaurants Open Late - 99.9 The Point
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; located approximately 4 miles east of campus.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast on College Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy pancakes and breakfast platters any time of night at this 24-hour location situated south of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A well-known breakfast chain offering 24-hour service on the main College Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP on College Avenue in Fort Collins is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Late Night Munchies? Top 5 Fort Collins Restaurants Open Late - 99.9 The Point
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily; located south of campus on College Ave.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study lounges, quiet corners, and specialized facilities that Colorado State University students use for late-night sessions and focused work beyond the main tour stops.

cards.title: 24/7 Study at The Cube
cards.subtitle: Morgan Library
cards.notes: Access this glass-walled study space 24/7 with your RamCard. It is located on the northwest side of the library and offers natural light and whiteboard access for late-night work.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour glass-walled study space located within the Morgan Library complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cube is open 24 hours and requires a RamCard for entry after 9:00 pm.
cards.source_title: Library Hours - CSU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; RamCard required for entry after 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Quiet Lounge in the LSC
cards.subtitle: Lory Student Center, Top Floor
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the Lory Student Center for a quiet, lodge-style atmosphere. This lounge features cushioned armchairs and ambient lighting away from the main food court noise.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, lodge-style lounge located on the top floor of the Lory Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Club is a lounge on the top floor of the Lory Student Center described as a quiet spot with a lodge vibe.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions
cards.access_notes: Open during Lory Student Center building hours.

cards.title: BSB Rooftop Patio
cards.subtitle: Behavioral Sciences Building
cards.notes: Visit the rooftop patio for an outdoor study session with views of the foothills. It is accessible via the main elevators and features tables and benches for student use.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor rooftop patio on the Behavioral Sciences Building providing study space and views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Behavioral Sciences Building features a rooftop patio and green roof used as a study and relaxation space.
cards.source_title: Behavioral Sciences Building | Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours, typically 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Study by the Living Wall
cards.subtitle: Warner College of Natural Resources
cards.notes: Study in the atrium next to the two-story living wall. This renovated space offers natural light, a scenic balcony, and a nature-inspired environment for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A modern study area in the Michael Smith Natural Resources Building featuring a large living wall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michael Smith Natural Resources Building features a two-story living wall and study spaces with natural light.
cards.source_title: Michael Smith Natural Resources Building | Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours.

cards.title: The TILT Great Hall
cards.subtitle: TILT Building
cards.notes: Utilize the Great Hall for group study and tutoring sessions. This historic building provides equipment checkout and a collaborative environment for students across all majors.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study and tutoring space located in the historic TILT building.
cards.evidence_claim: The TILT Great Hall offers equipment checkout, printing access, and space for tutoring and study groups.
cards.source_title: TILT Building | Institute for Learning and Teaching
cards.access_notes: Open during TILT business hours.

cards.title: Clark Building Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Clark Building, B-Wing
cards.notes: Find this dedicated study area in the Clark Building for a productive workspace. It features updated seating and lighting designed specifically for long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated, renovated study lounge located within the Clark Building complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clark Study Lounge project provided a dedicated area in the Clark building for a productive student study environment.
cards.source_title: Clark Study Lounge & Classroom Renovation | UFFAB
cards.access_notes: Open during Clark Building hours.

cards.title: Gregory Allicar Museum
cards.subtitle: University Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Take a break from studying to explore the galleries for free. Located in the UCA, this museum offers a quiet space to engage with art and fresh perspectives.
cards.short_summary: A free public art museum located on the southeast end of campus in the University Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gregory Allicar Museum of Art is free and open to all, located on the first floor of the University Center for the Arts.
cards.source_title: Visit - Gregory Allicar Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday-Saturday 10 AM-6 PM, Thursday until 7:30 PM, Sunday 1-5 PM.

cards.title: Annual Flower Trial Garden
cards.subtitle: Remington Street
cards.notes: Walk through over 1,000 cultivars of annuals in this outdoor research space. It is open daily during daylight hours and provides a scenic spot for a quiet walk.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor horticultural research garden featuring over 1,000 varieties of annual flowers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Annual Flower Trial Garden is open daily to the public, free of charge during daylight hours.
cards.source_title: About - CSU Flower Trial Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily during daylight hours.

cards.title: Richardson Design Center
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Use the collaborative spaces in this interdisciplinary makerspace. While some labs require a pass, the building offers modern, flexible areas for design thinking and group work.
cards.short_summary: An interdisciplinary design and fabrication center with collaborative student workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nancy Richardson Design Center provides a dynamic environment for creativity and collaboration across disciplines.
cards.source_title: Nancy Richardson Design Center | Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard building hours; fabrication labs require specific training/passes.

cards.title: Kindness Lounge Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Lory Student Center, Level 200
cards.notes: Study by the two-story rock fireplace in this sunken, carpeted lounge. Large windows provide natural light, making it a popular but comfortable spot for reading.
cards.short_summary: A cozy student lounge in the Lory Student Center featuring a large fireplace and floor-to-ceiling windows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Diane Warren Kindness Lounge in the Lory Student Center features a two-story rock fireplace and sunken floor.
cards.source_title: About the LSC - Lory Student Center
cards.access_notes: Open during Lory Student Center building hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Colorado State University's campus with these social activities and spaces that require no admission or purchase. From world-class art galleries to seasonal outdoor concerts, these spots offer free engagement for the student community.

cards.title: Browse the Allicar Art Galleries
cards.subtitle: University Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Walk through over 10,000 square feet of gallery space featuring rotating global art exhibits. The museum is always free and open to the public Wednesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A free public art museum at CSU featuring diverse global collections and rotating contemporary exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gregory Allicar Museum of Art is always free and open to all visitors, located on the first floor of the University Center for the Arts.
cards.source_title: Visit - Gregory Allicar Museum of Art | Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday-Saturday 10am-6pm (Thursday until 7:30pm) and Sunday 1pm-5pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

cards.title: Stroll the Flower Trial Gardens
cards.subtitle: Remington Street
cards.notes: Explore three acres of vibrant blooms where over 1,000 plant varieties are tested. This outdoor space is free and open daily during daylight hours for self-guided walks.
cards.short_summary: A public horticultural research garden showcasing over 1,000 varieties of annual flowers in a scenic campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The garden is open daily to the public, free of charge during daylight hours, and is located at 1401 Remington Street.
cards.source_title: Visit - CSU Flower Trial Gardens - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open daily during daylight hours. Peak blooming season is typically late May through October.

cards.title: View Contemporary Art at Curfman
cards.subtitle: Lory Student Center Level 200
cards.notes: Visit this student-centered gallery to see works from national artists and CSU students. It is located near the south entrance of the Lory Student Center and is free to enter.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary art gallery in the heart of the student center featuring professional and student exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Curfman Gallery provides a showcase for national and student artists and is free for visitors during its operating hours.
cards.source_title: Our Galleries - Lory Student Center - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 2pm-5pm during the academic year. Closed for installation periods.

cards.title: Attend a Free Lagoon Concert
cards.subtitle: LSC West Lawn
cards.notes: Bring a blanket to the Lory Student Center west lawn for free live music on Wednesday nights in the summer. The series features local bands and a community atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing summer tradition of free outdoor concerts held at the scenic campus lagoon.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lagoon Summer Concert Series is a free event held on Wednesday evenings from June through July on the LSC west lawn.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Lagoon Series – Lagoon Concert Series at CSU
cards.access_notes: Summer only; concerts typically run 6:30pm-8:30pm on Wednesdays from mid-June to late July.

cards.entity_name: Avenir Museum of Design and Merchandising
cards.title: Explore Historic Textiles
cards.subtitle: 216 E. Lake St.
cards.notes: See thousands of culturally significant textiles and historic costumes. This museum offers free admission to its three galleries located in the UCA-East building.
cards.short_summary: A university museum dedicated to the history and art of textiles, dress, and interior furnishings.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Avenir Museum of Design and Merchandising is free for all visitors during public hours.
cards.source_title: Avenir Museum of Design and Merchandising - Visit
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Friday 11am-5pm and Saturday 10am-4pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: Join a Free Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Full-time students can drop into over 25 different group fitness classes for free. Options include yoga, kickboxing, and Pilates led by certified instructors.
cards.short_summary: Free group exercise sessions for fee-paying students at the university's main recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU students with more than six credit hours may take any of the 28 group fitness classes for free at the Student Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Free and affordable options at the Colorado State Rec Center
cards.access_notes: Available to students enrolled in 6+ credits. Check the Rec Center schedule for daily class times.

cards.title: Listen to Free Music Recitals
cards.subtitle: University Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Attend vocal and instrumental recitals performed by music students throughout the semester. These performances are free and open to the public in various UCA halls.
cards.short_summary: Regularly scheduled musical performances by CSU students that are free for the community to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Student recitals at the University Center for the Arts are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Events - University Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Check the School of Music, Theatre, and Dance calendar for specific dates and times.

cards.title: See Native American Art
cards.subtitle: Lory Student Center Level 300
cards.notes: Visit this gallery dedicated to contemporary Native American art. It is located on the third floor of the LSC and is accessible during building hours at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A specialized gallery within the student center showcasing contemporary and traditional Native American artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duhesa Gallery exclusively displays contemporary Native American art and is free to the public during LSC hours.
cards.source_title: Our Galleries - Lory Student Center - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Lory Student Center building hours: Mon-Sat 7am-10pm, Sun 11am-11pm.

cards.title: Study in the Morgan Library
cards.subtitle: 1201 Center Avenue Mall
cards.notes: Utilize free public study areas and computer terminals in the university's main library. Students can also reserve private group study rooms for up to three hours daily.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering free study environments, technology access, and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Morgan Library offers free public access to study spaces and computer terminals, with room reservations available for students.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms - CSU Libraries - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check library website for current seasonal hours. NetID required for room reservations.

cards.title: Learn Skills at Outdoor Clinics
cards.subtitle: Rec Center Outdoor Program Suite
cards.notes: Attend free weekly clinics to learn skills like rock climbing anchors, navigation, or backcountry cooking. These sessions are held every Tuesday at 5pm.
cards.short_summary: Free educational workshops focused on outdoor recreation skills and safety.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor Program clinics are always free and held at 5pm every Tuesday in the Outdoor Program suite in the Rec Center.
cards.source_title: Colorado State University Outdoor Program - RamLink
cards.access_notes: Clinics are typically held on Tuesday evenings at 5pm during the academic semester.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: The Cube at Morgan Library
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Glass-Walled Study Space
cards.notes: Access this two-story glass-walled study space 24/7 with your RamCard. It offers natural light and views of the LSC Plaza for late-night or early-morning sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour glass-walled study pavilion attached to the Morgan Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Cube is a two-story building attached to the Morgan Library with full-length glass walls and 24/7 student access.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with RamCard access.

cards.title: The Great Hall at TILT
cards.subtitle: Historic Reading Room Environment
cards.notes: Study in CSU's original library reading room. This historic space features high ceilings and serves as a hub for tutoring and the Calculus Center.
cards.short_summary: A historic, high-ceilinged study hall located in the Institute for Learning and Teaching building.
cards.evidence_claim: First the Reading Room in CSU's original stand-alone library... the Great Hall is now a beautiful place to study and take advantage of the Calculus Center and TILT Tutoring.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The Institute for Learning and Teaching - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open during TILT building hours, typically Monday-Friday.

cards.title: Kindness Lounge
cards.subtitle: Sunken Lounge with Fireplace
cards.notes: Find a spot by the two-story rock fireplace in this sunken, carpeted lounge. Large windows provide ample natural light for daytime reading.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, centrally located lounge in the Lory Student Center featuring a large fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: With walls of windows, a sunken, carpeted floor, and a two-story rock fireplace, the Diane Warren Kindness Lounge in the Lory Student Center has all the good vibes.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the 200 level of the Lory Student Center; open during building hours.

cards.entity_name: Michael Smith Natural Resources Building Lounge
cards.title: The Living Wall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nature-Inspired Atrium Study
cards.notes: Study beside a multi-story living wall in the Michael Smith addition. This LEED-certified space features 'treehouse' meeting rooms and natural wood accents.
cards.short_summary: A modern, sustainable study lounge featuring a vertical garden and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michael Smith Natural Resources Building addition... includes flex conference space, living wall, extended atrium, and features treehouse meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: MICHAEL SMITH NATURAL RESOURCES BUILDING ADDITION - 4240 Architecture
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during Warner College of Natural Resources building hours.

cards.title: BSB Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Tech-Equipped Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve one of these modern rooms through the library portal for up to 3 hours. They are equipped with whiteboards and screens for group collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Private, reservable group study rooms located in the Behavioral Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms in the BSB can be reserved from the CSU libraries website... in thirty minute time blocks from 7:30AM to 11:30PM.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room - Exploratory Technology Resource Center
cards.access_notes: Reservable by CSU students; rooms available 7:30 AM to 11:30 PM.

cards.title: Scott 24-Hour Atrium
cards.subtitle: North Campus Study Hub
cards.notes: Utilize this 24-hour study area in the three-story atrium. It serves as a major study hub for the north side of campus with plenty of seating and outlets.
cards.short_summary: A large, 24-hour accessible atrium study space in the Scott Bioengineering Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Key components of this building are: A 24-hour study area within the three-story atrium that is open to all CSU students.
cards.source_title: Suzanne and Walter Scott, Jr. Bioengineering Building | University Facility Fee Advisory Board
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for all CSU students.

cards.title: Biology Building Nooks
cards.subtitle: Modern Science-Focused Seating
cards.notes: Find quiet seating areas throughout this newer building. Reservable group rooms are also available for up to 4 hours per day via the library system.
cards.short_summary: Modern study areas and reservable rooms within the CSU Biology Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Colorado State University Biology Building offers welcoming study spaces... Rooms can be reserved for a maximum of 4 hours per day.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation – Department of Biology | CSU
cards.access_notes: Building open Monday-Friday 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM; study rooms reservable via library portal.

cards.title: RDC Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary Maker Environment
cards.notes: Work in open, flexible layouts designed to increase social interaction. The third floor features dedicated collaboration spaces for design-focused projects.
cards.short_summary: Creative and collaborative study spaces within the Nancy Richardson Design Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Our three-story building houses... Collaboration spaces... Open, flexible layouts to increase social interactions and creative collaboration.
cards.source_title: Nancy Richardson Design Center Our Building - College of Health and Human Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open during RDC building hours; check college website for specific lab access.

cards.title: University Club Lounge
cards.subtitle: Quiet Lodge-Style Retreat
cards.notes: Escape to the top floor of the LSC for a 'lodge vibe' with cushioned armchairs and couches. It is typically quieter than the lower, high-traffic floors.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, lodge-style lounge located on the upper level of the Lory Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Club is a lounge adjacent to the Aspen Grille, and it boasts a cozy lodge vibe, complete with cushioned armchairs and big couches.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the 300 level of the Lory Student Center; open during building hours.

cards.title: Morgan Library Quiet Level
cards.subtitle: Deep Silence Study Zone
cards.notes: Head to the basement for the library's quietest environment. This level features a range of individual and group study rooms available by reservation.
cards.short_summary: The designated quietest level of the Morgan Library, featuring reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Morgan Library Layout: – Basement: Offers a range of study rooms you can reserve (Quietest Level).
cards.source_title: On-Campus Study Spaces - Peer-to-Peer Resources for CSU Community - WordPress.com
cards.access_notes: Open during Morgan Library hours; typically 9 AM to 11 PM Sunday-Thursday.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding Colorado State University, from the historic charm of Old Town to the student-centric hubs of Campus West.

cards.title: The Campus West Corridor
cards.subtitle: West Elizabeth Street
cards.notes: Walk or bike through the city's densest student housing area. This corridor connects the Main and Foothills campuses with essential retail and dining.
cards.short_summary: A primary student residential and commercial artery west of the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: West Elizabeth Street is a major arterial connecting CSU Main and Foothills campuses along a dense corridor of housing, restaurants, and retail.
cards.source_title: West Elizabeth Bus Rapid Transit Design Project | Our City - City of Fort Collins
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare accessible 24/7; primary transit route for Transfort buses.

cards.title: The Northern Campus Border
cards.subtitle: West Laurel Street
cards.notes: Visit the cafes and shops directly across from the Historic Oval. It is a popular spot for students to grab coffee or a burrito between classes.
cards.short_summary: A commercial block bordering the north side of campus near the Oval.
cards.evidence_claim: Mugs on Laurel is located at 306 W Laurel St, directly across the street from the Historic Oval at CSU.
cards.source_title: Mugs on Laurel | Downtown Fort Collins, CO
cards.access_notes: Sidewalks and businesses are generally open daily from early morning through evening.

cards.title: The Main Commercial Strip
cards.subtitle: South College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk along the eastern edge of campus to find alumni-owned restaurants and shops. This major road serves as the primary link to downtown.
cards.short_summary: The main north-south thoroughfare bordering the east side of the CSU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: College Avenue is a major street featuring many CSU alumni-owned businesses like Cafe Vino at 1200 S College Ave.
cards.source_title: Fort Collins CSU Alumni-Owned Businesses | Shops & Dining
cards.access_notes: Public street with wide sidewalks; businesses typically open 7am-10pm.

cards.title: The MAX Transit Corridor
cards.subtitle: Mason Street
cards.notes: Ride the MAX bus rapid transit along this dedicated north-south corridor. It connects the campus directly to the South Transit Center and Old Town.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated transit corridor running north-south through the heart of the city.
cards.evidence_claim: The MAX bus rapid transit route follows a dedicated transit-only guideway along the Mason Street corridor.
cards.source_title: MAX Bus Rapid Transit Service - RideTransfort
cards.access_notes: Transit service runs frequently; students ride free with a valid RamCard.

cards.title: The Historic Heart
cards.subtitle: Old Town Square
cards.notes: Experience the pedestrian-only plaza featuring splash pads, public art, and seasonal light shows in CSU's signature green and gold colors.
cards.short_summary: A historic pedestrian district and social hub located just north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Town Square features a splash pad with a green and gold light show during CSU Welcome Week.
cards.source_title: Downtown Fort Collins is a perfect campus escape
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian plaza open 24/7; light shows typically run 8pm to midnight.

cards.title: The Student Housing Hub
cards.subtitle: West Plum Street
cards.notes: Navigate this busy street lined with high-density student apartments. It serves as a key bike and bus link between the campus and City Park.
cards.short_summary: A major residential street for students located immediately west of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: West Plum Street is part of the West Elizabeth BRT project area and is a critical link for student housing.
cards.source_title: Elizabeth Transportation Project improves Foothills campus access - The Rocky Mountain Collegian
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; heavy bike and pedestrian traffic during school hours.

cards.title: The Scenic Boulevard
cards.subtitle: Mountain Avenue
cards.notes: Stroll down this wide, tree-lined boulevard featuring a historic trolley line. It is a picturesque route for students walking from campus to Old Town.
cards.short_summary: A historic, wide boulevard known for its trees and central trolley line.
cards.evidence_claim: Mountain Avenue is a key corridor in Fort Collins connecting Howes Street to the Lincoln Avenue Bridge.
cards.source_title: Mountain Avenue Reshaping Study | Our City
cards.access_notes: Public street; Birney Safety Streetcar operates seasonally on weekends.

cards.title: The Western Campus Edge
cards.subtitle: South Shields Street
cards.notes: Use the dedicated pedestrian underpass at Elizabeth Street to safely cross this high-traffic border between the main campus and Campus West.
cards.short_summary: A major north-south arterial forming the western boundary of the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shields Underpass provides safe access for bikes and pedestrians moving between campus and the Campus West area.
cards.source_title: Shields Underpass | Colorado State University - Building Success
cards.access_notes: Underpass is open 24/7 for pedestrian and bicycle use.

cards.title: The Southern Campus Link
cards.subtitle: West Prospect Road
cards.notes: Explore the southern edge of campus, home to the University Center for the Arts and quiet study spots like Arboretum Coffee.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west road bordering the south side of the CSU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Arboretum Coffee is located at 221 W Prospect Road, providing a community-oriented study haven near CSU.
cards.source_title: The Best Places for CSU Students to Study in Fort Collins - Arboretum Coffee
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; businesses along the road have varying daytime hours.

cards.title: The Plaza and Park Block
cards.subtitle: Oak Street
cards.notes: Relax at the Oak Street Plaza Park, a small urban green space near student housing and local shops just a short walk from the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A quiet street north of campus featuring a popular urban plaza park.
cards.evidence_claim: Oak Street Plaza Park is a notable spot near student housing and College America in Fort Collins.
cards.source_title: State Fort Collins Colorado Student Housing Overview
cards.access_notes: Plaza park is open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From painting a massive mountain monogram to the thunderous boom of a vintage cannon, Colorado State University's traditions celebrate its deep agricultural roots and spirited Ram family.

cards.title: Painting the A
cards.subtitle: A Century-Old Mountain Makeover
cards.notes: Join hundreds of students each August to whitewash the 450-foot 'A' on the hogback west of campus, a tradition dating back to 1923.
cards.short_summary: An annual event where students hike up the Maxwell Natural Area to repaint the massive 'A' monogram representing the school's Aggie heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'A' was first completed in September 1924 and is 450 feet tall; students continue to paint it annually in August.
cards.source_title: A 100-year old tradition | STATE - The Magazine of the Colorado State University System
cards.access_notes: The site is located in the Maxwell Natural Area; the painting event is organized by the Alumni Association.

cards.title: Firing Comatose
cards.subtitle: The Loudest Game Day Ritual
cards.notes: Listen for the thunderous boom of this 1918 French 75mm field gun, fired by Army ROTC cadets every time the Rams score a touchdown.
cards.short_summary: A vintage cannon named 'Comatose' that has been a fixture of CSU football games since 1920, signaling scores and kickoffs.
cards.evidence_claim: The tradition of firing a cannon during football games started in 1920; it is currently managed by Army ROTC cadets.
cards.source_title: Traditions - CSU Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Fired at Canvas Stadium during home football games.

cards.title: CAM the Ram's Sprint
cards.subtitle: The Official Animal Ambassador
cards.notes: Watch CAM the Ram and his student handlers sprint across the end zone during home games, a tradition since the mascot's naming in 1954.
cards.short_summary: The live Rambouillet ram mascot who leads the team onto the field and celebrates touchdowns with a spirited run.
cards.evidence_claim: CAM was officially named in 1954; student volunteers known as Ram Handlers manage his care and game-day sprints.
cards.source_title: CAM the Ram - CSU Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Appears at Canvas Stadium and various campus events; managed by the Alumni Association.

cards.title: Ringing the Old Main Bell
cards.subtitle: A Returned Historic Treasure
cards.notes: Celebrate Ram victories by ringing this 500-pound bell, which was stolen in 1919 and mysteriously returned to campus in 2016.
cards.short_summary: A historic bell from the original Old Main building that is now rung to signify football wins and other major university triumphs.
cards.evidence_claim: The bell was manufactured in 1894, stolen around 1919, and returned anonymously in 2016; it now hangs in the Alumni Center tower.
cards.source_title: The Old Main Bell: Historic treasure returns to campus
cards.access_notes: Located at the Iris & Michael Smith Alumni Center; rung during special events and after victories.

cards.title: The Bronze Boot Run
cards.subtitle: Border War Rivalry Ritual
cards.notes: Witness ROTC cadets relay the game ball 65 miles along Highway 287 between Fort Collins and Laramie before the annual Border War game.
cards.short_summary: A pre-game tradition where CSU and Wyoming ROTC cadets run the game ball to the state line to compete for a bronzed Vietnam combat boot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bronze Boot is a combat boot worn in Vietnam by Capt. Dan Romero; the relay run along U.S. 287 has been a ritual since the late 1960s.
cards.source_title: Bronze Boot Run - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: The run occurs on the Friday before the CSU vs. Wyoming football game.

cards.title: Nutrien Ag Day BBQ
cards.subtitle: Honoring Agricultural Roots
cards.notes: Feast on Colorado-grown food at this massive pre-game barbecue that has celebrated CSU's land-grant mission for over 40 years.
cards.short_summary: An annual celebration of Colorado agriculture featuring a large public BBQ and the football team wearing 'Aggie Orange' uniforms.
cards.evidence_claim: Ag Day has been a tradition for over 40 years; the event includes a BBQ showcasing Colorado commodities and orange throwback uniforms.
cards.source_title: Ag Day - Join Us
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the Ag Day BBQ site near Canvas Stadium; tickets required for the meal.

cards.title: Grill the Buffs
cards.subtitle: The Ultimate Rivalry Pep Rally
cards.notes: Eat a free burger and get hyped for the Rocky Mountain Showdown at this annual pep rally held on the Lory Student Center lawn.
cards.short_summary: A student-led tradition where thousands of free burgers are grilled to build spirit before the game against the CU Buffaloes.
cards.evidence_claim: The 14th annual Grill the Buffs was held in 2023; it is hosted by the Associated Students of CSU (ASCSU) and features free burgers.
cards.source_title: Colorado State celebrates 14th annual Grill the Buffs
cards.access_notes: Held on the Lory Student Center West Lawn during the week of the CU game.

cards.title: I Love CSU Day
cards.subtitle: A Statewide Proclamation of Pride
cards.notes: Wear green and gold every April 18th to celebrate this official Colorado holiday dedicated to Ram pride and community spirit.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide day of pride featuring on-campus festivities, tie-dye stations, and social media celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: I Love CSU Day is observed annually on April 18 by official governor proclamation; events include tie-dyeing and campus scavenger hunts.
cards.source_title: I Love CSU Day - CSU Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Celebrated across campus and online; primary hub is the Smith Alumni Center.

cards.title: Friday Night Lights Bonfire
cards.subtitle: Homecoming's Blazing Centerpiece
cards.notes: Gather on the LSC West Lawn for a massive bonfire, fireworks, and the lighting of the 'A' during Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: A historic Homecoming tradition featuring a large community bonfire and pep rally to welcome alumni back to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The bonfire tradition dates back to at least 1910; it is currently part of the 'Friday Night Lights' event during Homecoming.
cards.source_title: Friday Night Lights – CSU Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.access_notes: Held on the lawn west of the Lory Student Center; free and open to the public.

cards.title: Walking the Oval
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Stroll beneath the century-old American Elms in this historic heart of campus, a site for graduations and quiet reflection since 1909.
cards.short_summary: The iconic, elm-lined green space that serves as the symbolic center of the university and the site of major ceremonial traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oval was designed in 1909 and features 93 American Elms, some dating back to the 1880s; it is the primary site for graduation celebrations.
cards.source_title: The Oval: Preserving a Living Legacy
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible park-like space in the center of campus.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Colorado State University-Fort Collins, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In Day Check-In
cards.subtitle: The start of your Ram journey
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned hall during your scheduled time slot to collect your keys and start settling into your new home.
cards.short_summary: Official move-in process for new students living on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in for residence halls typically occurs on the Tuesday and Wednesday before classes begin.
cards.source_title: Move In Information - Housing & Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Requires a pre-registered arrival time slot via the CSU Housing Portal.

cards.title: Ram Welcome Carnival
cards.subtitle: Thursday night festivities
cards.notes: Head to the LSC West Lawn for a night of games, food, and music to celebrate your first week on campus.
cards.short_summary: An evening social event featuring carnival games and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ram Welcome Carnival is a scheduled evening event for all new students on the Thursday of orientation week.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Ram Welcome Full Schedule
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students; typically runs from 6:00 PM to 10:30 PM.

cards.title: Night @ the Rec
cards.subtitle: Late-night fitness and fun
cards.notes: Explore the climbing wall, pool, and courts during this special late-night event designed for new students.
cards.short_summary: A late-night open house at the campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Night @ the Rec is a signature Ram Welcome event held at the Student Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Hours - Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Late-night access provided specifically for orientation participants; RamCard required.

cards.title: University Convocation
cards.subtitle: The official academic kickoff
cards.notes: Join your classmates for the formal ceremony that marks the beginning of your academic career at CSU.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony welcoming the new class to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation is a required ceremony for first-year students held at Moby Arena on Friday morning.
cards.source_title: Convocation - Orientation and Transition Programs
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; clear bag policy is enforced at Moby Arena.

cards.title: Hike to the 'A'
cards.subtitle: A historic mountain tradition
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to the foothills and hike up to the iconic 'A' to learn about CSU's Aggie heritage.
cards.short_summary: A guided hike to the hillside 'A' landmark overlooking Fort Collins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hike to the A is an interest program offered during Ram Welcome for incoming students.
cards.source_title: CSU prepares for another year of traditions with Ram Welcome's annual Hike to The A
cards.access_notes: Bus pickup is typically at the Alumni Center; registration may be required.

cards.title: Libraries Welcome Back
cards.subtitle: Explore your study hub
cards.notes: Stop by the lobby for snacks, games, and to learn about research resources and printing services.
cards.short_summary: An open house event at the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morgan Library hosts a 'Welcome Back' event with snacks and games during the first week of classes.
cards.source_title: Library Hours - CSU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; RamCard required for entry after 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Plaza Welcome Days
cards.subtitle: The heart of campus life
cards.notes: Visit the central plaza for free ice cream, photo booths, and information from various campus organizations.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day resource fair held in the main campus plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Plaza Welcome Days occur from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM during the first week of the fall semester.
cards.source_title: First 50 Days - Orientation and Transition Programs
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; events typically run midday.

cards.title: Afternoon Garden Walk
cards.subtitle: A quiet campus escape
cards.notes: Walk through nearly three acres of vibrant blooms used for horticultural research and public enjoyment.
cards.short_summary: A public research garden featuring over 1,000 varieties of annuals.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSU Annual Flower Trial Gardens are open daily to the public free of charge during daylight hours.
cards.source_title: Visit - CSU Flower Trial Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily during daylight hours; located across from the University Center for the Arts.

cards.title: Explore Old Town
cards.subtitle: Beyond the campus gates
cards.notes: Take the MAX bus to downtown Fort Collins to browse local shops and enjoy lunch with new friends.
cards.short_summary: A trip to the historic downtown district of Fort Collins.
cards.evidence_claim: Ram Welcome includes scheduled times for students to explore Old Town Fort Collins, often via the MAX bus.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Ram Welcome Schedule
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the MAX bus; students often meet Ram Welcome Leaders for guided trips.

cards.title: Walk the Historic Oval
cards.subtitle: The heart of the university
cards.notes: Stroll under the century-old elm trees in the most historic and picturesque part of the CSU campus.
cards.short_summary: The historic central green space of the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oval was designed in 1909 and serves as the aesthetic heart of the Colorado State University campus.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions – CSU Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space available 24/7; central to many campus buildings.
